function.name: put_section
function.description: Incrementally create/update one chapter with parent/order, sources, complete template instances and pending response/proof positions. ID null creates a chapter. Every mutation requires the current draft digest and invalidates the previous render/review. Use source-grounded front_matter for root sections before the TOC; front matter has no child chapters and does not appear in the TOC. Omitted placement retains body behavior.

bindings.description: need is a requirement response or proof. field is a location in this template. Do not use the template record as need.

field.description: Select the actual location in this template. A grid template_region binds every explicitly selected anchor cell in that reviewed region, never the whole table or neighboring cells. A template_cell binds only that anchor. A text region binds its paragraph; a record target is the whole template and must not be used to claim a specific field correspondence.

function.name: inspect_composition
function.description: Paginate actual current presentation, chapters and omissions; includes current draft digest. Includes each rendered source excerpt, exact frozen parts and its separate pending-response location; all rows require independent inspection.

function.name: inspect_findings
function.description: Read independent review findings to repair the draft.

function.name: inspect_rendered
function.description: Read actual checked DOCX paragraphs and table geometry, not just planned content; table cells require inspect_rendered_cells pagination.

function.name: inspect_rendered_cells
function.description: Paginate actual rendered table anchors including text, blanks and merges. Every cell must be independently inspected before approval.

function.name: composition_coverage
function.description: Page the current obligation inventory. Copy obligation_ref into plan items; planned_items and implemented_sections are separate progress, never semantic acceptance. Omissions must cite original evidence.

function.name: inspect_placements
function.description: Read mappings of template regions/cells and response/proof needs to actual DOCX bookmarks/cells.

function.name: compile_docx
function.description: Generate and verify a new actual DOCX from the complete current draft. Keeps bytes in checkpoint; returns identity/counts, not base64. All template/response/proof and Rule.items obligations must be implemented or explicitly accounted for. Order-rule sequence IDs follow composition-item references to actual content targets, rejecting cycles; other items use their section locations. Distinct content blocks can prove order within a section; a shared bookmark cannot. Only valid saved omissions exclude sequence items. The host also compiles automatically after a complete successful batch. A deterministic compile failure is retained against the current draft; change the draft to resolve it before retrying.

function.name: request_composition_review
function.description: Request independent review of current compiled DOCX. Must be the only tool call in this turn. The host performs this transition automatically when the complete current draft compiles and no pending evidence or execution blocker remains; this manual entry remains available.

function.name: submit_composition_review
function.description: Aggregate all current plan-item judgments after complete original/draft/render inspection. findings may only repeat already saved findings; [] never clears item findings. Must be the only tool call.

function.name: set_composition_work
function.description: Save a bounded source and section task. Use actual frozen IDs. Host progress survives restart and scope renaming. Complete only after delivered source evidence and saved implementation (reviewer also needs a current independent per-item judgment). Blocked tasks cannot be accepted as source gaps.

plan_item_id.description: Host-assigned plan item identity. Presentation and report notes use this field and an empty section_scope.

function.name: check_composition_execution
function.description: Page host execution blockers separately from genuine source uncertainty. Blocked scopes prevent acceptance.

function.name: put_composition_review
function.description: Judge one inspected plan item and current artifact using independently read original grounds. Supply actionable findings or saved content-digest finding_ids; a new grounded judgment replaces only this item prior findings. Reading or inspection requested in the same batch is not delivered evidence. Wait for a subsequent model response containing those results before judging.
